001package dayplanner;
002
003
004/**
005 * <p>
006 * Represents a scheduled activity with a title, start time, end time, and
007 * optional comment.
008 * </p>
009 * <p>
010 * Serves as the base class for {@link HomeActivity}, {@link SchoolActivity},
011 * and {@link OtherActivity}.
012 * </p>
013 * <p>
014 * The class stores its {@link Time} references directly and enforces
015 * that the title is non-null and non-blank, start and end times are non-null,
016 * and the start time is strictly before the end time. Any violation of these
017 * invariant conditions causes an {@link IllegalArgumentException} to be thrown.
018 * For example:
019 * </p>
020 * <pre>
021 * Time start = new Time(2026, 10, 20, 14, 30);
022 * Time end = new Time(2026, 10, 20, 16, 30);
023 * Activity lab = new SchoolActivity("CIS 2430 Lab", start, end, "Bring laptop");
024 * </pre>
025 */
026public abstract class Activity implements Comparable<Activity> {
027    /**
028     * The title of this activity. Must be non-null and non-blank.
029     */
030    private String title;
031
032    /**
033     * The starting time of this activity. Must be non-null and strictly before endTime.
034     */
035    private Time startTime;
036
037    /**
038     * The ending time of this activity. Must be non-null and strictly after startTime.
039     */
040    private Time endTime;
041
042    /**
043     * Optional user comment or note associated with this activity.
044     */
045    private String comment;
046
047
048
049    /*
050     * Constructors
051     */
052
053    /**
054     * Protected default constructor for serialization and subclass initialization.
055     */
056    protected Activity() {}
057   
058    /**
059     * <p>
060     * Constructs an <code>Activity</code> with a title, start time, and end time.
061     * </p>
062     * 
063     * @param title     The activity title.
064     * @param startTime The start time.
065     * @param endTime   The end time.
066     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title is null or blank, if startTime or
067     *                                  endTime is null, or if startTime is not
068     *                                  strictly before endTime.
069     */
070    protected Activity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime)
071    throws IllegalArgumentException {
072        // Input validation is managed by the setters.
073        setTitle(title);
074        setStartTime(startTime);
075        setEndTime(endTime);
076    }
077
078    /**
079     * <p>
080     * Constructs an <code>Activity</code> with a title, start time, end time, and
081     * comment.
082     * </p>
083     * 
084     * @param title     The activity title.
085     * @param startTime The start time.
086     * @param endTime   The end time.
087     * @param comment   The activity comment.
088     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title is null or blank, if startTime or
089     *                                  endTime is null, or if startTime is not
090     *                                  strictly before endTime.
091     */
092    protected Activity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime, String comment)
093    throws IllegalArgumentException {
094        // Input validation is managed by the setters.
095        this(title, startTime, endTime);
096        setComment(comment);
097    }
098
099    /**
100     * <p>
101     * Constructs an <code>Activity</code> from a RAS (Readable Activity Serial)
102     * string. Tokens are parsed in the following order:
103     * </p>
104     * <ol>
105     * <li>class name (ignored),</li>
106     * <li>title,</li>
107     * <li>start time,</li>
108     * <li>end time,</li>
109     * <li>comment (<code>NIL</code> is treated as no comment).</li>
110     * </ol>
111     * 
112     * @param ras RAS entry, such as
113     *            {@code <HomeActivity,Laundry,2026/10/20 09:00,2026/10/20 10:00,NIL>}.
114     * @throws RasException when RAS input is invalid.
115     */
116    protected Activity(String ras)
117    throws RasException {
118        RasParser.populate(this, ras);
119    }
120
121    /**
122     * <p>
123     * Copy constructor. Constructs a new <code>Activity</code> that is a
124     * duplicate of the given <code>Activity</code>, preventing co-references
125     * that could cause privacy leaks.
126     * </p>
127     *
128     * @param other The <code>Activity</code> to copy.
129     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code other} is {@code null}.
130     */
131    protected Activity(Activity other)
132    throws IllegalArgumentException {
133        if (other == null)
134            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot copy a null Activity.");
135        setTitle(other.getTitle());
136        setStartTime(other.getStartTime()); // getStartTime() already returns a copy
137        setEndTime(other.getEndTime());     // getEndTime() already returns a copy
138        setComment(other.getComment());     // String is immutable; no copy needed
139    }
140
141
142
143    /*
144     * Accessors
145     */
146   
147    /**
148     * Gets the title of this activity.
149     * 
150     * @return The activity title.
151     */
152    public String getTitle() {
153        return this.title;
154    }
155    
156    /**
157     * Gets the start time of this activity.
158     *
159     * <p>Returns a defensive copy so that external mutations of the returned
160     * {@link Time} cannot affect this activity's internal state.</p>
161     * 
162     * @return A copy of the activity start time.
163     */
164    public Time getStartTime() {
165        return new Time(this.startTime);
166    }
167  
168    /**
169     * Gets the end time of this activity.
170     *
171     * <p>Returns a defensive copy so that external mutations of the returned
172     * {@link Time} cannot affect this activity's internal state.</p>
173     * 
174     * @return A copy of the activity end time.
175     */
176    public Time getEndTime() {
177        return new Time(this.endTime);
178    }
179    
180    /**
181     * Gets the comment for this activity.
182     * 
183     * @return The activity comment, or <code>null</code> if none is defined.
184     */
185    public String getComment() {
186        return this.comment;
187    }
188
189
190
191    /**
192     * Returns the {@link dayplanner.ActivityType} that corresponds to this
193     * Activity.
194     * 
195     * @return Corresponding ActivityType.
196     */
197    public abstract ActivityType getType();
198
199
200
201    /*
202     * Mutators
203     */
204    
205    /**
206     * Sets the title of this activity.
207     * 
208     * @param title The new title.
209     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title is null or blank.
210     */
211    public void setTitle(String title)
212    throws IllegalArgumentException {
213        if (title == null || title.isBlank())
214            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Title cannot be null or blank.");
215        
216        this.title = title;
217    }
218
219    /**
220     * Sets the start time of this activity.
221     *
222     * <p>Stores a defensive copy of {@code startTime} to prevent external
223     * mutations from affecting this activity's internal state.</p>
224     * 
225     * @param startTime The new start time.
226     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If startTime is null, or if an endTime is
227     *                                  already set and startTime is not strictly
228     *                                  before endTime.
229     */
230    public void setStartTime(Time startTime)
231    throws IllegalArgumentException {
232        if (startTime == null)
233            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Start time cannot be null.");
234        if (this.endTime != null
235            && startTime.compareTo(this.endTime) >= 0)
236            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Start time (" + startTime + ") must be before end time (" + this.endTime + ").");
237        
238        this.startTime = new Time(startTime);
239    }
240
241    /**
242     * Sets the end time of this activity.
243     *
244     * <p>Stores a defensive copy of {@code endTime} to prevent external
245     * mutations from affecting this activity's internal state.</p>
246     * 
247     * @param endTime The new end time.
248     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If endTime is null, or if a startTime is
249     *                                  already set and endTime is not strictly after startTime.
250     */
251    public void setEndTime(Time endTime)
252    throws IllegalArgumentException {
253        if (endTime == null)
254            throw new IllegalArgumentException("End time cannot be null.");
255        if (this.startTime != null
256            && this.startTime.compareTo(endTime) >= 0)
257            throw new IllegalArgumentException("End time (" + endTime + ") must be after start time (" + this.startTime + ").");
258        
259        this.endTime = new Time(endTime);
260    }
261
262    /**
263     * Sets the comment for this activity.
264     * 
265     * @param comment The new comment; null or blank values clear the comment.
266     */
267    public void setComment(String comment) {
268        if (comment == null || comment.isBlank())
269            this.comment = null;
270        else
271            this.comment = comment;
272    }
273
274
275
276    /*
277     * Serialization
278     */
279
280    /**
281     * <p>
282     * Encodes this activity into RAS (Readable Activity Serial) format.
283     * </p>
284     * <p>
285     * The RAS format is a comma-separated list wrapped in angle brackets, for
286     * example:
287     * </p>
288     * 
289     * <pre>
290     * &lt;ClassName,title,YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM,YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM,comment&gt;
291     * </pre>
292     * <p>
293     * If no comment is set, <code>NIL</code> is used as a placeholder. For example,
294     * a <code>HomeActivity</code> titled "Morning Run" with no comment might
295     * produce:
296     * </p>
297     * 
298     * <pre>
299     * &lt;HomeActivity,Morning Run,2026/01/01 07:00,2026/01/01 08:00,NIL&gt;
300     * </pre>
301     * 
302     * @return A single-line RAS representation; commas in field values are not
303     *         escaped.
304     */
305    public String toRAS() {
306        return RasParser.serialize(this);
307    }
308
309
310
311    /*
312     * Object Overrides
313     */
314
315    /**
316     * Returns a string representation of this activity.
317     * 
318     * @return A string representation of this activity.
319     */
320    @Override
321    public String toString() {
322        String str = String.format("%s (%s - %s)",
323            getTitle(),
324            getStartTime().toString(),
325            getEndTime().toString());
326
327        String comment = getComment();
328        if (comment != null && !comment.isBlank())
329            str = str + " (" + comment + ")";
330
331        return str;
332    }
333
334    /**
335     * Determines whether this activity is equal to another object.
336     * 
337     * @param other The object to compare with.
338     * @return <code>true</code> if the objects are equal, <code>false</code>
339     *         otherwise.
340     */
341    @Override
342    public boolean equals(Object other) {
343        if (this == other)
344            return true;
345        /*
346         * compare the class first. this is necessary because HomeActivity etc. are
347         * subclasses of this one and when comparing activities of different classes
348         * (i.e. HomeActivity and SchoolActivity), the two should always be treated as
349         * unequal.
350         */
351        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass())
352            return false;
353
354        Activity that = (Activity) other;
355
356        // compare title
357        if (getTitle() == null
358            ? that.getTitle() != null
359            : !getTitle().equals(that.getTitle()))
360            return false;
361
362        // compare start time
363        if (getStartTime() == null
364            ? that.getStartTime() != null
365            : !getStartTime().equals(that.getStartTime()))
366            return false;
367
368        // compare end time
369        if (getEndTime() == null
370            ? that.getEndTime() != null
371            : !getEndTime().equals(that.getEndTime()))
372            return false;
373
374        // compare comment
375        String c1 = getComment();
376        String c2 = that.getComment();
377        if (c1 == null || c1.isBlank())
378            return c2 == null || c2.isBlank();
379        return c1.equals(c2);
380    }
381
382    /**
383     * Compares this activity with another activity based on starting time.
384     * 
385     * @param other The other activity to compare with.
386     * @return A negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as this activity's
387     *         start time precedes, equals, or follows the other activity's start
388     *         time. Equal start times compare as zero even if other fields differ.
389     * @throws NullPointerException If {@code other} is {@code null}.
390     */
391    @Override
392    public int compareTo(Activity other)
393    throws NullPointerException {
394        if (other == null)
395            throw new NullPointerException("Cannot compare Activity to null");
396
397        /*
398         * since we are comparing based on a Time,
399         * which has its own compareTo method,
400         * we can just use that method :)
401         */
402        return getStartTime().compareTo(
403            other.getStartTime());
404    }
405}
